name: Java Jupyter Codespace
postCreateCommand: curl -Ls https://sh.jbang.dev | bash -s - app setup && export PATH="$HOME/.jbang/bin:$PATH" && pip3 install --user jupyter ipykernel && jbang trust add https://github.com && jbang install-kernel@jupyter-java && mkdir -p ~/.local/share/jupyter/kernels && ln -sf ~/.jbang/cache/jupyter/kernels/jjava ~/.local/share/jupyter/kernels/jjava
